response.original_title: ((FAQS Escalate))- How to escalate an issue with Carnival Cruise?
response.overview: To escalate an issue with Carnival Cruises, start by contacting Carnival Cruises at +1-866-829-1280 (Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–11 p.m. ET; Saturday–Sunday, 9 a.m.–9 p.m. ET) to request a supervisor or follow up on an unresolved booking, billing, or post-cruise concern. To escalate an issue with Carnival, +1-866-829-1280 start by contacting their standard support team with your booking or account details, request a supervisor +1-866-829-1280 or higher-tier team if unresolved, and use specialized channels for ethics/misconduct or regulatory disputes. Reach out to the relevant Carnival division +1-866-829-1280 and clearly explain the issue along with your booking or reference details. Call +1-866-829-1280 (Monday–Friday 8:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. ET, Saturday–Sunday 9:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. ET). Reach out via CarnivalCustomerService@Carnivalcruisesusa.com.
